row_definition: feature_asof >= holdout_start AND feature_asof <= holdout_end AND target_observable==true AND required frozen features available under PIT rules; censored/missing outcomes are EXCLUDED (never class 0, never imputed).
model_rule: static_frozen_model from final_candidate_freeze; no fitting/preprocessing-fit/feature-selection/calibration/retraining in holdout path.
primary_metric: monthly cross-sectional equal-weighted mean ROC-AUC skill (AUC - 0.5); equal month weighting.
primary_hypothesis: H0 mean monthly AUC_skill <= 0 vs H1 > 0.
primary_inference: deterministic one-sided HAC/Newey-West Bartlett t-test on monthly AUC skill with lag 12; p = SF(t) for t>0; if n<2 or invalid, result blocked/invalid not silently passed.

secondary_metrics.log_loss_skill_vs_final_base_rate: final-base-rate log loss minus model log loss

secondary_diagnostics: optional quintile hit-rate/economic descriptive metrics if straightforward; do NOT search multiple cutoffs.
